## Entity.setModelAnimationsPlaybackRate() method

Sets the playback rate for all of the entity's model animations.

**Signature:**

```typescript
setModelAnimationsPlaybackRate(playbackRate: number): void;
```

**Returns:**

## Remarks

A value of 1 is normal speed, 0.5 is half speed, 2 is double speed. A negative value will play the animation in reverse.
